title: ever.registry.person.deletion_requested v1 data
description: subject_hash = sha256 of the (iss, sub) pair so an installation can find its person_link without receiving the raw subject; idempotent

subject_hashes.description: subject_hashes (the request to one linked instance, on instance/{instance_id}): the hash of every (iss, sub) pair that instance holds a link for; subject_hash repeats the first. Absent on the platform's own record of the request.
